# Love & Marriage - living factions (court blocs world-wide by rule; household sides for players).
# Generated by the mod's faction generator.
# Two separate axes, as in history:
#  - HEART (attitude toward the crown): opinion, interests by vassal stance, kinship and office.
#  - NERVE (whether a faction dares to show it): the crown's strength (authority, legitimacy, dread,
#    armies, war, minority) against the faction's power and its leader's temper.
# A strong crown keeps a hostile faction quiet; a weak one lets it rise - or rallies the loyal.
# Vanilla factions are replaced (rule): landed vassals of courts in scope carry vanilla's own
# joining_faction_block flag (only ever our own, marked lam_fac_blocked), lifted when their faction rises.

lam_fac_clear_leader_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_count } remove_variable = lam_fac_count }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_osum } remove_variable = lam_fac_osum }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_loyal } remove_variable = lam_fac_loyal }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_power } remove_variable = lam_fac_power }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_share } remove_variable = lam_fac_share }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_stance } remove_variable = lam_fac_stance }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_plotters } remove_variable = lam_fac_plotters }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_attsum } remove_variable = lam_fac_attsum }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_att } remove_variable = lam_fac_att }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_stage } remove_variable = lam_fac_stage }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_bold } remove_variable = lam_fac_bold }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_friends_none } remove_variable = lam_fac_friends_none }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_foes_none } remove_variable = lam_fac_foes_none }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_gui_op } remove_variable = lam_gui_op }
	clear_variable_list = lam_fac_members
	clear_variable_list = lam_fac_friends
	clear_variable_list = lam_fac_foes
}

# Root = a vassal, scope:lam_fac_lordscope = their lord. Saves scope value lam_att (-100..100).
lam_fac_attitude_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = lam_att
		value = {
			value = "opinion(scope:lam_fac_lordscope)"
			multiply = 0.6
			if = { limit = { house ?= scope:lam_fac_lordscope.house } add = 20 }
			else_if = { limit = { dynasty ?= scope:lam_fac_lordscope.dynasty } add = 10 }
			if = { limit = { is_councillor_of = scope:lam_fac_lordscope } add = 15 }
			# A conqueror's court: no one dares stand against them.
			if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { lam_fac_awe_trigger = yes } } add = 50 }
			# Interests by stance.
			if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = courtly }
				if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { diplomacy >= 12 } } add = 10 }
				else = { add = -5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = glory_hound }
				if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { martial >= 12 } } add = 10 }
				if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { is_at_war = yes } } add = 5 }
				else = { add = -5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = parochial }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { var:lam_bloc ?= { is_alive = yes has_variable = lam_fac_law_ok } } scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { OR = { has_realm_law = crown_authority_2 has_realm_law = crown_authority_3 } } } add = -15 }
				else_if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { has_realm_law = crown_authority_0 } } add = 10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = zealot }
				if = { limit = { faith = scope:lam_fac_lordscope.faith } add = 15 }
				else = { add = -25 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = minority }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { culture = scope:lam_fac_lordscope.culture } } add = -10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = barons_and_minor_landholders }
				if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { OR = { has_realm_law = crown_authority_2 has_realm_law = crown_authority_3 } } } add = 10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = belligerent }
				if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { has_trait = brave } } add = 10 }
				else_if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { has_trait = craven } } add = -15 }
				if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { is_at_war = yes } } add = 5 }
			}
			# Family in the household: the voice of a consort's house at court.
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_inlaw }
				if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { has_variable = lam_harem_favorite } var:lam_fac_inlaw ?= scope:lam_fac_lordscope.var:lam_harem_favorite } add = 10 }
				if = { limit = { var:lam_fac_inlaw = { is_spouse_of = scope:lam_fac_lordscope } } add = 5 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:lam_fac_inlaw = { is_alive = yes opinion = { target = scope:lam_fac_lordscope value <= -20 } } }
					add = -15
				}
			}
			# A lord who keeps concubines against their shared faith.
			if = {
				limit = { scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { has_variable = lam_harem_sacrilege } faith = scope:lam_fac_lordscope.faith }
				add = -15
				if = { limit = { is_ruler = yes is_ruler = yes exists = liege is_landless_ruler = no is_vassal_of = liege has_vassal_stance = zealot } add = -15 }
			}
			# A faith the crown's faith calls hostile.
			if = {
				limit = {
					faith = {
						faith_hostility_level = {
							target = scope:lam_fac_lordscope.faith
							value >= faith_hostile_level
						}
					}
				}
				add = -20
			}
			min = -100
			max = 100
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = lam_gui_att value = scope:lam_att }


 if = { limit = { vip_actor = yes vic_running = yes scope:lam_fac_lordscope = { vip_court = yes } }
 if = { limit = { has_character_flag = vic_pledged_cassian } change_variable = { name = lam_gui_att add = 25 } }
 else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = vic_pledged_octavian } change_variable = { name = lam_gui_att add = -25 } }
 clamp_variable = { name = lam_gui_att min = -100 max = 100 }
 }

}

# Root = a lord. var:lam_crown 0..100 (needs var:lam_bloc_total, the vassals' summed strength).
lam_crown_strength_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = lam_crown value = lam_tune_crown_base }
	if = { limit = { has_realm_law = crown_authority_0 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_realm_law = crown_authority_2 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_realm_law = crown_authority_3 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 20 } }
	if = { limit = { legitimacy_level >= 4 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 12 } }
	else_if = { limit = { legitimacy_level >= 3 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { legitimacy_level <= 1 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { dread >= 70 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 20 } }
	else_if = { limit = { dread >= 40 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { prestige_level >= 4 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war_as_defender = yes } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { age < 16 } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -15 } }
	# (A scandal born of a forbidden household is already counted in the sacrilege: one cause, at most -25.)
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_scandal NOT = { has_variable = lam_harem_sacrilege } } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -8 } }
	# Concubines kept against the faith: the crown's moral standing is gone.
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_harem_sacrilege } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -15 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_harem_sacrilege_weak } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -10 } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = lam_cmil value = max_military_strength }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = lam_bloc_total var:lam_bloc_total > 0 }
		if = { limit = { scope:lam_cmil >= var:lam_bloc_total } change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 15 } }
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:lam_cmil >= { value = var:lam_bloc_total multiply = 0.5 } }
			change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:lam_cmil < { value = var:lam_bloc_total multiply = 0.25 } }
			change_variable = { name = lam_crown add = -10 }
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { name = lam_crown min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# On a leader: start the card (scope:lam_fac_lordscope = the lord).
lam_fac_init_leader_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = lam_fac_count value = 1 }
	clear_variable_list = lam_fac_core
	clear_variable_list = lam_fac_clients
	clear_variable_list = lam_fac_sym
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = lam_fac_founded } } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_founded value = current_year } }
	set_variable = { name = lam_fac_age value = current_year }
	change_variable = { name = lam_fac_age subtract = var:lam_fac_founded }
	if = { limit = { var:lam_fac_age >= 40 } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_age_tier value = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:lam_fac_age >= 15 } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_age_tier value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:lam_fac_age >= 5 } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_age_tier value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = lam_fac_age_tier value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = lam_fac_cohesion } } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_cohesion value = 50 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = lam_fac_gen } } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_gen value = 1 } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = lam_fop value = "opinion(scope:lam_fac_lordscope)" }
	set_variable = { name = lam_fac_osum value = scope:lam_fop }
	set_variable = { name = lam_gui_op value = scope:lam_fop }
	set_variable = { name = lam_fac_plotters value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { joined_faction ?= { faction_target = scope:lam_fac_lordscope } }
		change_variable = { name = lam_fac_plotters add = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = lam_fac_attsum value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = lam_gui_att }
		set_variable = { name = lam_fac_attsum value = var:lam_gui_att }
	}
}

# On a member (LEADER): add to the card.
lam_fac_add_member_effect = {
	save_scope_as = lam_fac_m
	save_scope_value_as = { name = lam_fop value = "opinion(scope:lam_fac_lordscope)" }
	set_variable = { name = lam_gui_op value = scope:lam_fop }
	$LEADER$ = {
		add_to_variable_list = { name = lam_fac_members target = scope:lam_fac_m }
		if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_m = { var:lam_fac_tier ?= 1 } } add_to_variable_list = { name = lam_fac_core target = scope:lam_fac_m } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:lam_fac_m = { var:lam_fac_tier ?= 2 } } add_to_variable_list = { name = lam_fac_clients target = scope:lam_fac_m } }
		else = { add_to_variable_list = { name = lam_fac_sym target = scope:lam_fac_m } }
		change_variable = { name = lam_fac_count add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = lam_fac_osum add = scope:lam_fop }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = lam_gui_att }
		$LEADER$ = { change_variable = { name = lam_fac_attsum add = scope:lam_fac_m.var:lam_gui_att } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { joined_faction ?= { faction_target = scope:lam_fac_lordscope } }
		$LEADER$ = { change_variable = { name = lam_fac_plotters add = 1 } }
	}
}

# On a leader: finish the card (TOTAL = total power; CROWN = the crown's strength 0..100).
lam_fac_finish_leader_effect = {
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_loyal
		value = var:lam_fac_osum
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_loyal
		divide = var:lam_fac_count
	}
	remove_variable = lam_fac_osum
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_att
		value = var:lam_fac_attsum
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_att
		divide = var:lam_fac_count
	}
	remove_variable = lam_fac_attsum
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_power
			$TOTAL$ > 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_share
			value = var:lam_fac_power
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_share
			multiply = 100
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_share
			divide = $TOTAL$
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_share
			value = 0
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_bold
		value = 100
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_bold
		subtract = $CROWN$
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = lam_fsh
		value = {
			value = var:lam_fac_share
			multiply = 0.5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_hide
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_fsh
			value = {
				value = var:lam_fac_share
				multiply = 0.25
			}
		}
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_bold
		add = scope:lam_fsh
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 10
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = brave
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 10
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = vengeful
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = craven
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = -15
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = content
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = -10
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_grievance
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 15
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_spurned
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_betrayed
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 15
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_wary
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 10
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_crowned
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = -10
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			lam_fac_heir_mismatch_trigger = {
				LORD = scope:lam_fac_lordscope
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = 10
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_fear
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = -15
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_appeased
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = -25
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:lam_fac_lordscope = {
				lam_fac_awe_trigger = yes
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_bold
			add = -40
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nfc
		value = {
			value = 100
			subtract = $CROWN$
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nfs
		value = scope:lam_fsh
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nft
		value = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = ambitious
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = brave
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = vengeful
				}
				add = 5
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = craven
				}
				add = -15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = content
				}
				add = -10
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nfg
		value = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_grievance
				}
				add = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_spurned
				}
				add = 20
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_betrayed
				}
				add = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_wary
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					lam_fac_heir_mismatch_trigger = {
						LORD = scope:lam_fac_lordscope
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nfx
		value = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_crowned
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_fear
				}
				add = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_appeased
				}
				add = 25
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_fac_lordscope = {
						lam_fac_awe_trigger = yes
					}
				}
				add = 40
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nf1v
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nf2v
		value = 0
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_nf1
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_nf1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_nf2
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_nf2
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = {
				value = 100
				subtract = $CROWN$
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf1v
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2v
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1v
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1
				value = flag:crown
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf2v
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2
				value = flag:crown
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = scope:lam_fsh
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf1v
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2v
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1v
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1
				value = flag:share
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf2v
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2
				value = flag:share
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = {
				value = 0
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_trait = ambitious
					}
					add = 10
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_trait = brave
					}
					add = 10
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_trait = vengeful
					}
					add = 5
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf1v
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2v
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1v
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1
				value = flag:temper
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf2v
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2
				value = flag:temper
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_grievance
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf1v
			}
			if = {

				}
				set_variable = {

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_spurned
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = 20
		}
		if = {

			}

				value = flag:spurned
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_betrayed
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf1v
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {

				value = flag:betrayed
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf2v
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2
				value = flag:betrayed
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_wary
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf1v
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {

			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			lam_fac_heir_mismatch_trigger = {
				LORD = scope:lam_fac_lordscope
			}
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_nfv
			value = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf1v
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_nf2v
					value = var:lam_fac_nf1v
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1
				value = flag:heir
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf1v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_nfv > var:lam_fac_nf2v
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2
				value = flag:heir
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_nf2v
				value = scope:lam_nfv
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			lam_fac_hold_trigger = {
				LORD = scope:lam_fac_lordscope
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_holding
			value = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_holding
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_holding
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:lam_fac_att <= -15
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_bold >= 110
				has_variable = lam_fac_share
				var:lam_fac_share >= 10
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_hide
					}
					var:lam_fac_share >= 20
				}
				NOT = {
					lam_fac_hold_trigger = {
						LORD = scope:lam_fac_lordscope
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					scope:lam_fac_lordscope = {
						lam_fac_awe_trigger = yes
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_bold >= 85
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 3
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_bold >= 60
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 2
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:lam_fac_att >= 25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				$CROWN$ >= 50
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 6
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_stage
			value = 7
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			has_variable = lam_fac_posture
			NOT = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_armed
			}
			NOT = {
				var:lam_fac_stage ?= 4
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_posture ?= flag:loyal
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					$CROWN$ >= 50
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_stage
					value = 5
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_stage
					value = 6
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:lam_fac_att <= -15
				}
				lam_fac_cohesion_add_effect = {
					ADD = -3
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_posture ?= flag:watch
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 7
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_posture ?= flag:quiet
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 1
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_posture ?= flag:oppose
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 2
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:lam_fac_att >= 25
				}
				lam_fac_cohesion_add_effect = {
					ADD = -3
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_posture ?= flag:arm
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_stage
				value = 3
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:lam_fac_att >= 0
				}
				lam_fac_cohesion_add_effect = {
					ADD = -3
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:lam_fac_lordscope = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_ban
			}
			NOT = {
				lam_fac_legal_trigger = {
					LORD = scope:lam_fac_lordscope
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				var:lam_fac_stage ?= 4
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_stage
			value = 9
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_oath
			OR = {
				var:lam_fac_stage ?= 2
				var:lam_fac_stage ?= 3
				var:lam_fac_stage ?= 4
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_stage
			value = 1
		}
	}
	lam_cr_finish_political_effect = yes
	lam_wc_sync_effect = yes
}

lam_fac_relate_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				$A$ = {
					has_relation_rival = $B$
				}
				$A$ = {
					has_relation_nemesis = $B$
				}
				$A$ = {
					opinion = {
						target = $B$
						value <= -15
					}
				}
				$B$ = {
					opinion = {
						target = $A$
						value <= -15
					}
				}
				$A$.house ?= {
					any_house_relation = {
						any_relation_house = {
							this = $B$.house
						}
						OR = {
							has_house_relation_level = feud
							has_house_relation_level = rivalry
						}
					}
				}
				AND = {
					$A$ = {
						var:lam_fac_heir ?= {
							is_alive = yes
						}
					}
					$B$ = {
						var:lam_fac_heir ?= {
							is_alive = yes
						}
					}
					NOT = {
						$A$.var:lam_fac_heir = $B$.var:lam_fac_heir
					}
				}
				AND = {
					$A$ = {
						var:lam_fac_att >= 25
					}
					$B$ = {
						var:lam_fac_att <= -15
					}
				}
				AND = {
					$B$ = {
						var:lam_fac_att >= 25
					}
					$A$ = {
						var:lam_fac_att <= -15
					}
				}
			}
		}
		$A$ = {
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = lam_fac_foes
				target = $B$
			}
		}
		$B$ = {
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = lam_fac_foes
				target = $A$
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				$A$ = {
					has_relation_friend = $B$
				}
				$A$ = {
					has_relation_best_friend = $B$
				}
				$A$.house ?= {
					any_house_relation = {
						any_relation_house = {
							this = $B$.house
						}
						OR = {
							has_house_relation_level = friendly
							has_house_relation_level = amity
						}
					}
				}
				AND = {
					$A$ = {
						opinion = {
							target = $B$
							value >= 30
						}
					}
					$B$ = {
						opinion = {
							target = $A$
							value >= 30
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		$A$ = {
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = lam_fac_friends
				target = $B$
			}
		}
		$B$ = {
			add_to_variable_list = {
				name = lam_fac_friends
				target = $A$
			}
		}
	}
	lam_cr_relations_effect = {
		A = $A$
		B = $B$
	}
}

# Root = a person, scope:lam_bloc_lord, scope:lam_att saved: how drawn into court politics they are (var lam_fac_engage).
# Temperament, standing, strong feelings, and the times: a weak crown, a war, a new reign.
lam_fac_engage_effect = {
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = lam_eng
		value = {
			value = lam_tune_engage_base
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = ambitious
				}
				add = 20
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = arrogant
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					intrigue >= 14
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = content
				}
				add = -20
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_trait = shy
				}
				add = -10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_councillor_of = scope:lam_bloc_lord
				}
				add = 25
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler = yes
					is_powerful_vassal = yes
				}
				add = 20
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					prestige_level >= 3
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:lam_att >= 40
						scope:lam_att <= -40
					}
				}
				add = 15
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:lam_att >= 25
						scope:lam_att <= -25
					}
				}
				add = 8
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord.var:lam_crown < 35
				}
				add = 22
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord.var:lam_crown < 45
				}
				add = 11
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord.var:lam_crown >= 65
				}
				add = -22
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						is_at_war = yes
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_newreign
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_ban
					}
				}
				add = -15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_bloc_lead
					}
					NOT = {
						lam_pd_has_valid_allegiance_trigger = yes
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						lam_pd_local_activity_value < 30
					}
					add = -10
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						lam_pd_local_activity_value >= 60
					}
					add = 10
				}
			}
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_engage
		value = scope:lam_eng
	}
}

# Root = a lord: is a faction seat open?
lam_fac_seat_open_effect = {
if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_seat_open } remove_variable = lam_fac_seat_open } if = { limit = { lam_ff_normal_seat_open_trigger = yes } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_seat_open value = yes } }
}

# A faction's lasting self, carried by its leader (not recomputed): favour, agenda, name, founding.
# Root = new leader: a fresh identity (agenda = their own stance).
lam_fac_new_identity_effect = {
	remove_variable = lam_hi_record_evicted
	lam_ss_clear_birth_effect = yes
	lam_pd_identity_clear_effect = yes
	lam_pd_grievance_clear_effect = yes
	lam_pd_clear_effect = yes
	lam_pol_drop_state_effect = yes
	lam_cr_drop_patronage_effect = yes
	lam_fac_review_state_drop_effect = yes
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_favour
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_founded
		value = current_year
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_gen
		value = 1
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_founder
		value = this
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_cohesion
		value = 50
	}
	clear_variable_list = lam_fac_lineage
	lam_fac_timeline_add_effect = {
		KEY = founded
	}
	lam_fac_heritage_claim_effect = yes
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_fac_nmv
		value = 0
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital_county.duchy
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_region
			value = capital_county.duchy
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = liege.capital_county.duchy
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_region
			value = liege.capital_county.duchy
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ruler = yes
			exists = liege
			is_landless_ruler = no
			is_vassal_of = liege
			has_vassal_stance = courtly
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:courtly
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ruler = yes
			exists = liege
			is_landless_ruler = no
			is_vassal_of = liege
			has_vassal_stance = glory_hound
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:glory_hound
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ruler = yes
			exists = liege
			is_landless_ruler = no
			is_vassal_of = liege
			has_vassal_stance = parochial
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:parochial
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ruler = yes
			exists = liege
			is_landless_ruler = no
			is_vassal_of = liege
			has_vassal_stance = zealot
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:zealot
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ruler = yes
			exists = liege
			is_landless_ruler = no
			is_vassal_of = liege
			has_vassal_stance = minority
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:minority
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ruler = yes
			exists = liege
			is_landless_ruler = no
			is_vassal_of = liege
			has_vassal_stance = barons_and_minor_landholders
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:barons_and_minor_landholders
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ruler = yes
			exists = liege
			is_landless_ruler = no
			is_vassal_of = liege
			has_vassal_stance = belligerent
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:belligerent
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_agenda
			value = flag:none
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = lam_bloc_lead
		value = yes
	}
	lam_gn_found_effect = yes
}

		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_lord_wrong_m
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_end_why
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_end_why
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_end_into
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_end_into
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gn_from
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gn_from
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_gn_why
		}
		remove_variable = lam_gn_why
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_disband
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_disband
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_bloc_lead
		}
		remove_variable = lam_bloc_lead
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_prevstage
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_prevstage
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_goal
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_goal
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_goal_met
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_goal_met
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_goal_was
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_goal_was
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_unmet
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_unmet
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_few
		}

	}

		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_alone
		}

	}
	lam_fac_clear_leader_effect = yes
	lam_wc_clear_effect = yes
	remove_variable = lam_wc_home
	lam_cs_identity_clear_effect = yes
}

############################
# A realm's factions. Root = the lord (player or AI). Factions persist between pulses.
############################
lam_bloc_update_effect = {
	save_scope_as = lam_bloc_lord
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				any_vassal = {
					is_ai = no
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_fast
			value = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_fac_fast
		}
		remove_variable = lam_fac_fast
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_vassal = {
				lam_fac_peer_trigger = yes
				count >= 8
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_csize
			value = 3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_vassal = {
				lam_fac_peer_trigger = yes
				count >= 4
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_csize
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_csize
			value = 1
		}
	}
	save_scope_as = lam_fac_lordscope
	lam_cs_snapshot_effect = yes
	every_in_list = {
		variable = lam_bloc_leads
		limit = {
			is_alive = yes
			NOT = {
				liege ?= {
					NOT = {
						this = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					}
					is_target_in_variable_list = {
						name = lam_bloc_leads
						target = prev
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_stage
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_prevstage
				value = var:lam_fac_stage
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = lam_cl_h
		clear_variable_list = lam_fac_prev_members
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_fac_members
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
			}
			scope:lam_cl_h = {
				add_to_variable_list = {
					name = lam_fac_prev_members
					target = prev
				}
			}
		}
		lam_fac_clear_leader_effect = yes
	}
	clear_variable_list = lam_bloc_unaligned
	clear_saved_scope = lam_bl1
	clear_saved_scope = lam_bl2
	clear_saved_scope = lam_bl3
	clear_saved_scope = lam_bl4
	clear_saved_scope = lam_bl5
	clear_saved_scope = lam_bl6
	clear_saved_scope = lam_bl7
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = lam_bloc_leads_none
		}
		remove_variable = lam_bloc_leads_none
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_vassal = {
				lam_fac_peer_trigger = yes
			}
		}
		clear_variable_list = lam_fac_pool
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_bloc_total
			value = 0
		}
		ordered_vassal = {
			limit = {
				lam_fac_peer_trigger = yes
			}
			order_by = max_military_strength
			max = 80
			check_range_bounds = no
			lam_fac_attitude_effect = yes
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_weighed
				value = scope:lam_bloc_lord
				days = 400
			}
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = lam_bpw
				value = max_military_strength
			}
			scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_bloc_total
					add = scope:lam_bpw
				}
			}
			scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
				add_to_variable_list = {
					name = lam_fac_pool
					target = prev
				}
			}
		}
		every_councillor = {
			limit = {
				is_ruler = no
				is_alive = yes
			}
			lam_fac_attitude_effect = yes
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_weighed
				value = scope:lam_bloc_lord
				days = 400
			}
			scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
				add_to_variable_list = {
					name = lam_fac_pool
					target = prev
				}
			}
		}
		lam_crown_strength_effect = yes
		lam_pol_refresh_engagement_effect = yes
		clear_variable_list = lam_bloc_newleads
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_bloc_leads
			save_scope_as = lam_old_lead
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = yes
					liege ?= scope:lam_bloc_lord
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_disband
					}
				}
				scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
					add_to_variable_list = {
						name = lam_bloc_newleads
						target = scope:lam_old_lead
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					has_variable = lam_bloc_lead
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_disband
					}
					liege ?= {
						NOT = {
							this = scope:lam_bloc_lord
						}
						is_target_in_variable_list = {
							name = lam_bloc_leads
							target = scope:lam_old_lead
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				clear_saved_scope = lam_succ
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_alive = yes
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_disband
						}
					}
					lam_fac_pick_successor_effect = {
						LORD = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:lam_succ
					}
					lam_fac_pass_identity_effect = {
						FROM = scope:lam_old_lead
						TO = scope:lam_succ
					}
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						add_to_variable_list = {
							name = lam_bloc_newleads
							target = scope:lam_succ
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								is_ai = no
							}
							lam_fac_digest_add_effect = {
								KEY = succ
								WHO = scope:lam_succ
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						is_alive = yes
						scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
							is_ai = no
						}
					}
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						lam_fac_digest_add_effect = {
							KEY = ends
							WHO = scope:lam_old_lead
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_alive = yes
						NOT = {
							exists = scope:lam_succ
						}
					}
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						save_scope_as = lam_hk_lord
					}
					lam_fac_heritage_keep_effect = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_alive = yes
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_disband
						}
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_end_why
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = lam_fac_end_why
						value = flag:left
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_alive = yes
					}
					lam_fac_drop_identity_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
		clear_variable_list = lam_bloc_leads
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_bloc_newleads
			scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
				add_to_variable_list = {
					name = lam_bloc_leads
					target = prev
				}
			}
		}
		clear_variable_list = lam_bloc_newleads
		ordered_vassal = {
			limit = {
				lam_pol_founder_trigger = yes
			}
			order_by = lam_pol_founder_value
			max = 6
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = lam_new_lead
			lam_cs_found_context_effect = yes
			clear_saved_scope = lam_nf_home
			scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_in_list = {
							variable = lam_bloc_leads
						}
					}
					ordered_in_list = {
						variable = lam_bloc_leads
						limit = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									is_alive = yes
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_fac_disband
									}
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_fac_hide
									}
									lam_fac_cause_of_trigger = {
										WHO = scope:lam_new_lead
									}
									scope:lam_new_lead = {
										OR = {
											opinion = {
												target = prev
												value >= lam_pd_absorb_threshold_value
											}
											AND = {
												trigger_if = {
													limit = {
														exists = prev.house
													}
													house ?= prev.house
												}
												trigger_else = {
													always = no
												}
											}
											has_relation_friend = prev
											has_relation_best_friend = prev
										}
									}
								}
								lam_cu_internal_home_trigger = yes
							}
						}
						order_by = {
							value = "opinion(scope:lam_new_lead)"
						}
						save_scope_as = lam_nf_home
						max = 1
						check_range_bounds = no
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:lam_nf_home
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_bloc
					value = scope:lam_nf_home
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_tier
					value = 1
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_pinned
					value = yes
					months = 24
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_proto
					}
					remove_variable = lam_fac_proto
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
								has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
							}
						}
					}
					lam_fac_stat_add_effect = {
						KEY = absorb
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
								var:lam_fac_csize ?= 1
							}
							var:lam_fac_engage >= lam_tune_found_lead_engage
							scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
								any_in_list = {
									variable = lam_fac_pool
									count >= 1
									NOT = {
										this = scope:lam_new_lead
									}
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_bloc_lead
									}
									has_variable = lam_fac_engage
									var:lam_fac_engage >= lam_tune_found_follow_engage
									OR = {
										NOT = {
											has_variable = lam_bloc
										}
										var:lam_fac_tier ?= 3
									}
									OR = {
										opinion = {
											target = scope:lam_new_lead
											value >= lam_pd_found_support_threshold_value
										}
										AND = {
											trigger_if = {
												limit = {
													exists = scope:lam_new_lead.house
												}
												house ?= scope:lam_new_lead.house
											}
											trigger_else = {
												always = no
											}
										}
										has_relation_friend = scope:lam_new_lead
									}
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_fac_unbound
									}
									is_ai = yes
									trigger_if = {
										limit = {
											scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
												lam_ev_established_court_trigger = yes
											}
										}
										lam_cu_independent_supporter_trigger = yes
									}
								}
							}
						}
						AND = {
							scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
								var:lam_fac_csize ?= 2
							}
							scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
								any_in_list = {
									variable = lam_fac_pool
									count >= 2
									NOT = {
										this = scope:lam_new_lead
									}
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_bloc_lead
									}
									has_variable = lam_fac_engage
									var:lam_fac_engage >= lam_tune_found_follow_engage
									OR = {
										NOT = {
											has_variable = lam_bloc
										}
										var:lam_fac_tier ?= 3
									}
									OR = {
										opinion = {
											target = scope:lam_new_lead
											value >= lam_pd_found_support_threshold_value
										}
										AND = {
											trigger_if = {
												limit = {
													exists = scope:lam_new_lead.house
												}
												house ?= scope:lam_new_lead.house
											}
											trigger_else = {
												always = no
											}
										}
										has_relation_friend = scope:lam_new_lead
									}
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_fac_unbound
									}
									is_ai = yes
									trigger_if = {
										limit = {
											scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
												lam_ev_established_court_trigger = yes
											}
										}
										lam_cu_independent_supporter_trigger = yes
									}
								}
							}
						}
						scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
							any_in_list = {
								variable = lam_fac_pool
								count >= 3
								NOT = {
									this = scope:lam_new_lead
								}
								NOT = {
									has_variable = lam_bloc_lead
								}
								has_variable = lam_fac_engage
								var:lam_fac_engage >= lam_tune_found_follow_engage
								OR = {
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_bloc
									}
									var:lam_fac_tier ?= 3
								}
								OR = {
									opinion = {
										target = scope:lam_new_lead
										value >= lam_pd_found_support_threshold_value
									}
									AND = {
										trigger_if = {
											limit = {
												exists = scope:lam_new_lead.house
											}
											house ?= scope:lam_new_lead.house
										}
										trigger_else = {
											always = no
										}
									}
									has_relation_friend = scope:lam_new_lead
								}
								NOT = {
									has_variable = lam_fac_unbound
								}
								is_ai = yes
								trigger_if = {
									limit = {
										scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
											lam_ev_established_court_trigger = yes
										}
									}
									lam_cu_independent_supporter_trigger = yes
								}
							}
						}
					}
					lam_cu_root_open_trigger = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_proto
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = lam_fac_proto
						value = 0
						years = 3
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
							NOT = {
								has_variable = lam_fac_fast
							}
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = lam_fac_proto
						add = 4
					}
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = {
						name = lam_fac_proto
						add = 1
					}
				}
				scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
					lam_fac_seat_open_effect = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:lam_fac_proto >= lam_ev_found_prepare_value
						scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_seat_open
							NOT = {
								has_variable = lam_fac_newcd
							}
						}
					}
					lam_co_root_context_effect = yes
					remove_variable = lam_fac_proto
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						add_to_variable_list = {
							name = lam_bloc_leads
							target = scope:lam_new_lead
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								NOT = {
									has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
								}
							}
							set_variable = {
								name = lam_fac_newcd
								value = yes
								months = lam_cu_new_root_cooldown_value
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								is_ai = no
								NOT = {
									has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
								}
							}
							lam_fac_digest_add_effect = {
								KEY = new
								WHO = scope:lam_new_lead
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								NOT = {
									has_variable = lam_fac_founded
								}
								NOT = {
									has_variable = lam_fac_nmv
								}
							}
						}
						lam_fac_new_identity_effect = yes
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
									has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
								}
							}
						}
						lam_co_root_record_effect = yes
						lam_fac_stat_add_effect = {
							KEY = new
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = lam_bloc_lead
						value = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_proto
				}
				remove_variable = lam_fac_proto
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_seat_open
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_seat_open
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_bloc_leads
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_bloc
				value = this
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_rec
					}
				}
				lam_gn_found_effect = yes
			}
			lam_fac_init_leader_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_gui_att
				}
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = lam_att
					value = var:lam_gui_att
				}
			}
			else = {
				save_scope_value_as = {
					name = lam_att
					value = 0
				}
			}
			lam_fac_engage_effect = yes
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_power
				value = max_military_strength
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler = yes
					exists = liege
					is_landless_ruler = no
					is_vassal_of = liege
					has_vassal_stance = courtly
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_stance
					value = flag:courtly
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler = yes
					exists = liege
					is_landless_ruler = no
					is_vassal_of = liege
					has_vassal_stance = glory_hound
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_stance
					value = flag:glory_hound
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler = yes
					exists = liege
					is_landless_ruler = no
					is_vassal_of = liege
					has_vassal_stance = parochial
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_stance
					value = flag:parochial
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler = yes
					exists = liege
					is_landless_ruler = no
					is_vassal_of = liege
					has_vassal_stance = zealot
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_stance
					value = flag:zealot
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler = yes
					exists = liege
					is_landless_ruler = no
					is_vassal_of = liege
					has_vassal_stance = minority
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_stance
					value = flag:minority
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_ruler = yes
					exists = liege

			}
			every_in_list = {
				variable = lam_bloc_leads
				save_scope_as = lam_fac_turn
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:lam_fac_stage ?= 3
						NOT = {
							var:lam_fac_prevstage ?= 3
						}
						NOT = {
							var:lam_fac_prevstage ?= 4
						}
					}
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						send_interface_message = {
							type = event_generic_bad
							title = lam_fac_turn_mobilise_title
							right_icon = scope:lam_fac_turn
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						var:lam_fac_stage ?= 6
						NOT = {
							var:lam_fac_prevstage ?= 6
						}
					}
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						send_interface_message = {
							type = event_generic_good
							title = lam_fac_turn_rally_title
							right_icon = scope:lam_fac_turn
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						var:lam_fac_stage ?= 1
						OR = {
							var:lam_fac_prevstage ?= 2
							var:lam_fac_prevstage ?= 3
						}
					}
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						lam_fac_digest_add_effect = {
							KEY = quiet
							WHO = scope:lam_fac_turn
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
				}
			}
			lam_fac_life_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
				}
			}
			lam_fac_admin_pulse_effect = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_bloc_leads
			lam_fac_none_flags_effect = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_in_list = {
					variable = lam_bloc_leads
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_bloc_leads_none
			value = yes
		}
	}
	lam_dr_audit_previous_effect = yes
}

# Root = the lord, after the cards. Favour drifts and is earned; weak factions fade; friends merge; rivals split.
lam_fac_life_effect = {
	lam_cs_court_effect = yes
	every_in_list = {
		variable = lam_bloc_leads
		save_scope_as = lam_fl
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_favour
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_favour
				value = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_fast
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_favour
				multiply = 0.982
			}
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_favour
				multiply = 0.93
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_councillor_of = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					any_in_list = {
						variable = lam_fac_members
						var:lam_fac_tier ?= 1
						is_councillor_of = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_fast
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_favour
					add = 1
				}
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_favour
					add = 4
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_spouse = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:lam_bloc_lord
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_fast
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_favour
					add = 0.75
				}
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_favour
					add = 3
				}
			}
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_favour
			min = -100
			max = 100
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_favour >= 40
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						this = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					}
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					modifier = lam_fac_favoured_opinion
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				variable = lam_fac_members
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						this = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					}
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					modifier = lam_fac_favoured_opinion
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_favour <= -40
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						this = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					}
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					modifier = lam_fac_slighted_opinion
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				variable = lam_fac_members
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						this = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					}
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:lam_bloc_lord
					modifier = lam_fac_slighted_opinion
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_cp_broken_m
				var:lam_fac_cp_broken_m <= lam_now_m
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_cp_broken_m
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
				scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
					var:lam_fac_puppet_master ?= prev
				}
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_cp_warned_m
				}
				remove_variable = lam_fac_cp_warned_m
			}
		}
		lam_cr_cp_maintain_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_cp_was
				value = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_share
				var:lam_fac_share < 8
				NOT = {
					lam_ss_establishing_trigger = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					lam_cs_union_pending_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_weak
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_weak
					value = 0
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_weak
				add = 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
								NOT = {
									has_variable = lam_fac_fast
								}
							}
							var:lam_fac_weak >= 2
						}
						var:lam_fac_weak >= 8
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 0
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = lam_fac_disband
						value = yes
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 1
						OR = {
							AND = {
								scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
									NOT = {
										has_variable = lam_fac_fast
									}
								}
								var:lam_fac_weak >= 4
							}
							var:lam_fac_weak >= 16
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = lam_fac_disband
						value = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_weak
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_weak
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						var:lam_fac_count < 2
						scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
							var:lam_fac_csize ?= 3
						}
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_cp_was
						}
					}
					AND = {
						var:lam_fac_count < 2
						scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
							var:lam_fac_csize ?= 2
						}
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_cp_was
						}
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					lam_ss_establishing_trigger = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					lam_cs_union_pending_trigger = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_rv_found_grace
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_few
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_few
					value = 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_fast
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_few
					add = 4
				}
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_few
					add = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:lam_fac_few >= 4
					OR = {
						var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 0
						var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 1
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_disband
					value = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_few
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_few
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_count
				var:lam_fac_count < 2
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_cp_was
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_rv_found_grace
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_alone
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_alone
					value = 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_fast
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_alone
					add = 4
				}
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_alone
					add = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:lam_fac_alone >= 2
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_disband
					value = yes
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_end_why
					value = flag:alone
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_alone
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_alone
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_engage
				var:lam_fac_engage < 20
				is_ai = yes
				OR = {
					var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 0
					var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 1
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_disband
				value = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_cohesion
				var:lam_fac_cohesion <= 10
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_cp_was
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_frail
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_frail
					value = 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_fast
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_frail
					add = 4
				}
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_frail
					add = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:lam_fac_frail >= 5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_disband
					value = yes
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = lam_fac_end_why
					value = flag:collapsed
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_frail
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_frail
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_cp_was
			}
			remove_variable = lam_fac_cp_was
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_cohesion
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_cohesion
				value = 50
			}
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_coh_t
			value = lam_fac_cohesion_target_value
		}
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = lam_coh_d
			value = {
				value = scope:lam_coh_t
				subtract = var:lam_fac_cohesion
				multiply = 0.1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_fast
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = lam_coh_d
				value = {
					value = scope:lam_coh_t
					subtract = var:lam_fac_cohesion
					multiply = 0.35
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					scope:lam_bloc_lord = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_cohesion
				add = scope:lam_coh_d
			}
		}
		clamp_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_cohesion
			min = 0
			max = 100
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 3
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_character_modifier = lam_fac_venerable_modifier
					}
				}
				add_character_modifier = {
					modifier = lam_fac_venerable_modifier
					months = 13
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:lam_fac_age_tier ?= 2
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_character_modifier = lam_fac_old_modifier
					}
				}
				add_character_modifier = {
					modifier = lam_fac_old_modifier
					months = 13
				}
			}
		}
	}
	lam_cr_court_party_effect = yes
}

lam_fac_none_flags_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { any_in_list = { variable = lam_fac_friends } } } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_friends_none value = yes } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { any_in_list = { variable = lam_fac_foes } } } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_foes_none value = yes } }
}

############################
# Absorbing vanilla factions (root = a lord in scope, rule lam_fac_absorb_on).
############################
lam_fac_absorb_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			lam_pb_managed_court_trigger = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_bloc_leads
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					OR = {
						var:lam_fac_stage ?= 3
						var:lam_fac_stage ?= 4
					}
					lam_rv_rise_cause_trigger = yes
					lam_pb_can_propose_trigger = yes
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_fac_rebel_cd
					}
				}
				lam_fac_rise_effect = yes
			}
		}
		every_vassal = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
				}
				lam_fac_unblock_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		lam_pb_absorb_legacy_effect = yes
	}
}

# Root = a faction head; scope:lam_abs_lord = their lord. The faction takes up arms through vanilla's
# own factions (claimant, independence, liberty), else in open defiance. Used by AI heads and the player's decision.
lam_fac_rise_effect = {
lam_cr_start_effect = { ISSUE = rise ACTION = rise TARGET = liege }
}

# Vanilla's joining_faction_block, set by us only where vanilla has not set it, and lifted only where we set it.
lam_fac_block_effect = {
if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_blocked value = yes days = 400 } }
}
lam_fac_unblock_effect = {
remove_variable = lam_fac_blocked
}

############################
# Household sides -> the same cards (root = the lord; after lam_harem_clique_effect).
############################
lam_clique_cards_effect = {
	save_scope_as = lam_cq_lord
	save_scope_as = lam_fac_lordscope
	every_in_list = {
		variable = lam_harem_clique_leads
		# (A political faction's head keeps their own card.)
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = lam_bloc_lead } }
		lam_fac_clear_leader_effect = yes
		lam_fac_init_leader_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = lam_fac_power value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { is_spouse_of = scope:lam_cq_lord } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_stance value = flag:tradition } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:lam_cq_lord = { var:lam_harem_favorite ?= prev } } set_variable = { name = lam_fac_stance value = flag:favour } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = lam_fac_stance value = flag:ambition } }
		save_scope_as = lam_cq_lead
		scope:lam_cq_lord = {
			every_in_list = {
				variable = lam_harem_circle
				limit = {
					var:lam_clique ?= scope:lam_cq_lead
					NOT = { this = scope:lam_cq_lead }
				}
				lam_fac_add_member_effect = { LEADER = scope:lam_cq_lead }
				scope:lam_cq_lead = { change_variable = { name = lam_fac_power add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = lam_cq_total value = 0 }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = lam_harem_circle
		scope:lam_cq_lord = { change_variable = { name = lam_cq_total add = 1 } }
	}
	every_in_list = {
		variable = lam_harem_clique_leads
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = lam_bloc_lead } }
		lam_fac_finish_leader_effect = { TOTAL = scope:lam_cq_lord.var:lam_cq_total CROWN = 50 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_fac_stage } remove_variable = lam_fac_stage }
	}
	remove_variable = lam_cq_total
	every_in_list = {
		variable = lam_harem_clique_leads
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = lam_bloc_lead } }
		save_scope_as = lam_cq_a
		scope:lam_cq_lord = {
			every_in_list = {
				variable = lam_harem_clique_leads
				limit = { NOT = { this = scope:lam_cq_a } NOT = { has_variable = lam_bloc_lead } }
				if = {
					limit = { opinion = { target = scope:lam_cq_a value <= -15 } }
					scope:lam_cq_a = { add_to_variable_list = { name = lam_fac_foes target = prev } }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { opinion = { target = scope:lam_cq_a value >= 30 } }
					scope:lam_cq_a = { add_to_variable_list = { name = lam_fac_friends target = prev } }
				}
			}
		}
		lam_fac_none_flags_effect = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = lam_harem_clique_leads_none } remove_variable = lam_harem_clique_leads_none }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { any_in_list = { variable = lam_harem_clique_leads } } }
		set_variable = { name = lam_harem_clique_leads_none value = yes }
	}
}

############################
# Entry points.
############################
# A lord's realm, on its pulse (seasons where a player sits, years elsewhere).
lam_fac_realm_pulse_effect = {
	lam_pb_takeover_effect = yes
	lam_wc_court_sync_effect = yes
	lam_pb_court_membership_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			lam_fac_vanilla_politics_trigger = yes
		}
		every_vassal = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_blocked
			}
			lam_fac_unblock_effect = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				lam_fac_realm_in_scope_trigger = yes
			}
			any_in_list = {
				variable = lam_bloc_leads
			}
			NOT = {
				lam_wc_court_at_war_trigger = yes
			}
			NOT = {
				lam_wc_wartime_trigger = yes
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = lam_rp_lord
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_bloc_leads
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
				}
				remove_variable = lam_fac_courtparty
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = lam_bloc_lead
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							exists = liege
						}
						liege = scope:lam_rp_lord
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_fac_end_why
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = lam_fac_end_why
						value = flag:fall
					}
				}
				lam_fac_drop_identity_effect = yes
			}
		}
		clear_variable_list = lam_bloc_leads
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_bloc_leads_none
			value = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			lam_fac_realm_in_scope_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					lam_wc_court_at_war_trigger = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					lam_wc_wartime_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			lam_fac_adopt_orphans_effect = yes
			lam_bloc_update_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			lam_fac_quick_refresh_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_game_rule = lam_fac_absorb_on
			}
			lam_fac_absorb_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
				}
			}
			lam_fac_defiance_refresh_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
				}
			}
			lam_fac_heirs_effect = yes
			lam_is_pulse_effect = yes
		}
		lam_fac_inlaw_signals_effect = yes
		lam_fac_promises_effect = yes
		lam_fac_petition_effect = yes
		lam_fac_clash_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
			}
			lam_fac_digest_effect = yes
		}
		lam_fac_ai_coerce_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_ai_cd
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_ai_cd
				value = yes
				days = 350
			}
			lam_fac_ai_lord_effect = yes
			lam_fac_ai_ban_effect = yes
		}
		lam_fac_outlaw_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
				}
			}
			lam_fac_badges_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
			}
			lam_fac_inlaw_effect = yes
		}
	}
	lam_wc_court_sync_effect = yes
	lam_pb_unaligned_pulse_effect = yes
}
# The player's window, fresh (root = the player; scope:lam_fac_view_target = the realm viewed).
lam_factions_refresh_effect = {
 vip_refresh_opening_blocs = yes
 if = { limit = { vip_actor = yes } lam_fac_default_view_effect = yes 
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_variable = lam_fac_view
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = lam_fac_view
			value = this
		}
	}
	var:lam_fac_view = {
		lam_wc_court_sync_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = {
						lam_fac_realm_in_scope_trigger = yes
					}
					NOT = {
						has_variable = lam_crown
					}
					AND = {
						NOT = {
							any_in_list = {
								variable = lam_bloc_leads
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							has_variable = lam_bloc_leads_none
						}
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					lam_wc_court_at_war_trigger = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					lam_wc_wartime_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = lam_fac_viewonly
				value = yes
			}
			lam_bloc_update_effect = yes
			remove_variable = lam_fac_viewonly
		}
	}
	lam_clique_cards_effect = yes
	var:lam_fac_view ?= {
		lam_wc_court_sync_effect = yes
		lam_pb_refresh_fronts_effect = yes
	}
	vip_refresh_opening_blocs = yes
 lam_ux2_sort_effect = yes

vip_refresh_public = yes
 } }

# FROM's faction now led by TO (polish 066): a player head hears what carries on; player members are told.
lam_fac_succession_brief_effect = {
	$TO$ = {
		save_scope_as = lam_sb_new
		$FROM$ = { save_scope_as = lam_sb_old }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:lam_sb_old } } trigger_event = lam_faction.3020 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = lam_fac_members
			limit = { is_alive = yes is_ai = no NOT = { this = scope:lam_sb_new } NOT = { has_character_flag = lam_sb_told } }
			add_character_flag = { flag = lam_sb_told days = 5 }
			send_interface_message = { type = event_generic_neutral title = lam_fac_succ_brief_title right_icon = scope:lam_sb_new }
		}
	}
}

# Root = the head closing a gathering (event 2610): the players who attended hear what was resolved (polish 030).
lam_fac_gather_note_effect = {
	scope:lam_ga ?= {
		every_attending_character = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { this = root } }
			send_interface_message = { type = event_generic_neutral title = lam_fac_gather_note_$KEY$ right_icon = root }
		}
	}
}
